Ana (Growth): Quick sync: we need a compact benchmark narrative for next week's launch. Core ask: make the latency vs cost tradeoff obvious in a single sweep.
Mike P: Two-panel hero sounds best: left = tokens/sec (throughput), right = $ per 1k tokens (unit cost). Add a small callout with p95 numbers.
Drew (Prod): Agreed. Also include a short note about config sensitivity (batching, cache, quant) so folks don't overgeneralize.
Sarah - Content: Tone options: 1) advisory - 'Match your serving to your SLAs', 2) declarative - 'Save X% vs baseline'. I prefer 1 for broad appeal.
Ana (Growth): Can we make a safe quantified claim? Something like '~30% p95 improvement on our reference workload'. Need the backup.
Mike P: Backup exists on M-arch reference. Real numbers: p95 down ~28% with our runtime tuning vs baseline. I'll push CSV to #marketing-assets.
Drew (Prod): Appendix config to include. Snippet: ```json
{"batch_tokens":512,"concurrency_limit":8,"kv_cache":true}
```
Sarah - Content: Webinar hooks: live stress test, rerank cost breakdown, 10-min Q&A on rollouts/fallbacks. Landing CTA: 'See your tokens per dollar in 2 minutes'.
Design Bot: Landing page mock uploaded: /design/webinar-bench-hero-v2.png
Ana (Growth): Inbound flow: sign-up -> lightweight benchmark kit (script + sample prompts) -> auto-score -> SDR touch for >$5k MRC leads.
Mike P: I'll add a CSV export and a tiny calculator so users can drop their latency profile and get $/k tokens.
Drew (Prod): I'll supply p95/p99 + small tail histograms for chat, assistant, rerank workloads to populate appendix.
Sarah - Content: Action items: Mike = metrics + kit export; Drew = configs + latency artifacts; Sarah = slide copy + two email variants; Design = hero comps. Target: rehearsal by EOD Thu.
Ana (Growth): Thanks team. Keep the hero simple, put the nuance in the appendix. :rocket:
